body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`): two more project home pages get a figure, each drawn by `experiments/figure.py` (stdlib only) from the committed `results.json`, nothing retyped.

- `robofab-grasp`: MuJoCo vs analytic grip force, 33 cases, largest deviation 4.5%.
- `robofab-jointspeed`: optimised vs minimum-jerk move time against the joint-speed cap, 9 configurations.

`python3 site/build.py` → `ok: 460 projects, 4036 tests`; both project pages pick up the SVG.
